title: demiurge — Architecture SSOT (JSON tree)
ssot_note: JSON=SSOT (AI/tool parse); humans view ARCHITECTURE.html. Prose mirror = ARCHITECTURE.md. Faithful transcription of ARCHITECTURE.md + README.md + CLAUDE.md + QFORGE/QFORGE.md — no invented nodes/numbers (commons c9).
overview: demiurge is a universal, hexa-native technical-design architecture program: it drives any engineering system through one 7-verb pipeline, with each field plugged in as a manifest-only domain (single generic dispatch, no per-domain code — governance d4). It is the meta-conductor: chip, accelerator, superconductor, spacecraft, and BCI 'desks' all live in one building. Two surfaces sit on the same pipeline: a Next.js web GUI (human surface) and a hexa-native CLI (AI-agent surface). Reusable implementation is owned by the sibling hexa-lang repo — demiurge is a typed-interface consumer, never an absorber (d3).
pipeline_note: One generic 7-verb dispatch (manifest-driven, d4). CLI (cli/) and web GUI (web/) both traverse the same path.

meta_conductor_chain.note: rfc_004 §4 — typed seam contracts between passes. Upstream = hexa-lang (d17).

Architecture prose SSOT (update-in-place). This JSON tree mirrors it.

data_flow: Input = a domain manifest (domains/<DOMAIN>.md) and/or a compute deck (decks/<cell>). Adding/renaming/removing a variant is manifest-only (d4).
Pipeline = the generic 7-verb dispatch, driven from cli/ (CLI surface) or web/ (GUI surface) — both traverse the same path.
Verification = hexa verify gates; a passing result is folded directly into the atlas atom (embedded.gen.hexa, the audit SSOT — no intermediate ledger files, d_atlas_as_audit_ssot).
Output = records under exports/ / .verdicts/; a terminal verified discovery becomes a paper under PAPER(S)/<slug> (gated: terminal verdict + significance).

governance.rule: Implementation lives in one canonical home (hexa-lang); demiurge consumes only.
Single generic dispatch; instances are manifests, never hardcoded names in the generic layer.
Drive every non-wet-lab step to completed-form; absorbed=true ⇔ all non-wet-lab gates PASS.
Validated decks fire compute campaigns autonomously (no user gate on cost-bearing rent).
Web-GUI deploy stays user-approval-gated; compute autonomy unaffected.
Parallel-first; GRID-parallel compute to the walltime floor.
First-principles physics breaks the ML training-distribution wall; never force a target number / present under-converged value (honest).

QFORGE.name: QFORGE — 양자 대장간 (hexa-native first-principles el-ph engine)
QFORGE.goal: Remove the external QE dependency; compute element→electronic structure→phonon→el-ph λ→Allen-Dynes/Eliashberg Tc end-to-end natively. Results g5 verbatim-verified + atlas-folded. RTSC ← QFORGE (NEXUS reuse edge).
QFORGE.honest_standing: QE = production reference; QFORGE migration gate HELD (2026-06-15). Two PRODUCTION modes (a, b) + one converging-but-gate-unmet mode (c) + a magnetism mode (d).

modes.title: bare full-basis vertex (QFORGE-only, 0 QE-moment dependence)
modes.what: QFORGE's own SCF→DFPT→el-ph |g|² (bare ∂V_bare vertex, screening OFF) → α²F → λ.
modes.accuracy: CaH6 λ = 4.13647 · rel-ε 5.47% vs QE 4.376 (npw_cap=0 full ecut shell n=645). Self-consistent from-scratch estimate WITHOUT QE moments.
modes.use: Fast rough λ screening (~5.5% band). Not gate-grade (<1%) — use mode (b).

modes.title: hybrid (QE |g|² → QFORGE L3 assembler), gate-grade
modes.what: Feed real QE DFPT el-ph harvest (.elph = per-mode λ(q,ν)+ω(q,ν)) into QFORGE's verified α²F→λ→Tc assembler (qforge_gaussian_delta + qforge_a2f_lambda + Allen-Dynes/McMillan). Assembler = ~/.hx/src/stdlib/qforge/assembler.hexa.
modes.accuracy: CaH6 rel-ε 1.65e-7 · LaH10 rel-ε 4.75e-7 (σ_ph→0 monotone convergence ng=8000).
modes.honest_scope: NOT a from-scratch engine — still needs QE |g|²/DFPT as input (does not replace DFPT). It is the verified λ/Tc assembler. Bottleneck = DFPT (candidate dispatch — cost, user-deferred).

modes.title: from-scratch SCREENED vertex (Woodbury Dyson ε⁻¹ + live local-field f_xc[ρ(r)])
modes.status: 🟢 converging, gate NOT MET — track HELD
modes.what: QFORGE's own self-consistent screened vertex, fully independent of QE.
modes.frontier: R7 (2026-06-08) broke past the bare baseline for the first time: λ=4.1518 vs QE 4.376, rel-ε=5.12% < bare 5.47%. R8 (GGA f_xc-in-χ) COMPLETE · CLOSED-NEGATIVE (λ_GGA=3.41256, rel-ε 22.02%; Δλ vs ALDA −0.00257 = no difference). DFT f_xc lever exhausted; residual gap = from-scratch LDA-PW SCF (QE is PBE self-consistent). Next lever = from-scratch PBE-SCF (separate large effort).
modes.gate: ≤1% NOT MET (5.12% > 1%); not flipped, 4.376 not forced (d6).

modes.title: QFORGE-LSDA magnetism engine (nspin=2 spin-DFT)
modes.what: QFORGE's own nspin=2 spin-polarized SCF (V_xc spin-split LDA/PW92 + spin-GGA PBE) → magnetic moment m.
modes.bricks: All g5 PASS (qforge_scf_spin_selftest, qforge_scf_pw_spin_selftest, qforge_smearing_spin_selftest, qforge_xc_spin_selftest, qforge_pbe_spin_selftest). Engine works.
modes.wall: Real-cell moment SCF blocked by TM-d/5d PW cost. CoSn (Co-3d, npw≥120) ≈580s/iter; only npw=80 tractable → under-resolved m≈0 (QE m=0.43 not reproduced — basis wall, not physics). RbOs2O6 (Os-5d, 9-atom) heavier → honest-skip on mini local. Breakthrough = GPU davidson / reduced-basis (LCAO/PAW) / real HPC.

layers.note: Bottom-up build (completeness-first, top-down L0…L5). All engine layers DONE.
layers.L0: Allen-Dynes/McMillan Tc layer — reused atoms, qforge_l0_selftest PASS (Nb anchor ∈ [9.9,13]K).
layers.L3: α²F(ω) ASSEMBLER (double-δ BZ sum) — qforge_l3_selftest 13/13 PASS; QE-validated (YH10 rel-ε 9.76e-5, CaH6 1.65e-7).
layers.L4: DFPT phonons (dynmat assembler + phonon solver) — dfpt_selftest 11/11 PASS.
layers.L5: Plane-wave SCF building blocks 5/5 (3D FFT · UPF parser · MP grid · Davidson · Sternheimer) all DONE + g5 PASS.
layers.integrations: KS-SCF driver (scf.hexa) · Sternheimer→force-constant adapter · real Hartree+XC screening kernel (Hartree + LDA x+c, PW92 + PBE-GGA correlation) · metallic real-cell SCF convergence (smearing + Anderson mixing, CaH6 converged true).

migration_gate.data_half: 3/3 TERMINAL (CaH6 · LaH10 · Li2MgH16 QE el-ph assembled). qforge_migration_gate_test CaH6 rel-ε 1.4e-4 PASS.
migration_gate.accuracy_half: front-end QFORGE-own |g| accuracy (independent CaH6 λ=0.18, 24× MISS — screened-vertex gap). Separate end-to-end milestone.
migration_gate.verdict: HELD — routing-switch (gate ALL_PASS) and full QE replacement (end-to-end |g| within 1%) are distinct stages.

QFORGE.universal_axis: Multi-scale extension (atoms · materials · bio · chem · chip · system) on a common core (plane-wave DFT + linear-response DFPT + stdlib/autograd·flame ML) with per-scale front-end + g5 verify-adapter (2026-06-07). materials = DONE (QE el-ph, GATE CLOSED); others new.

QE.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (external Fortran, 30-yr verified)
QE.role: Current PRODUCTION reference for candidate Tc + magnetism. All RTSC-session DFT (RbOs2O6 magnetism · ScH9/MgH6/ScH6/YH6 DFPT · CsOs2O6 · CaH10/SrH10) ran QE-only (2026-06-15). QFORGE assembler is immediately-usable gate-grade on top of QE |g|².
QE.production_prereq: High-P hydride el-ph runs MUST pass a dynamical-stability pre-check (tight vc-relax at target P → matdyn asr='crystal' → confirm 0 imaginary phonon modes) BEFORE the el-ph production run (2026-06-15 fleet diagnostic, c1).

flat_band_at_EF.title: no-cooling flat-band-at-E_F track (DESIGN gate, not room-temp)

winners.detail: campaign-first: measured ΔE=−0.055 eV AND m=0.00 μB — beats all 3 failure modes; real ambient Tc=7K. Next = DFPT λ/Tc promotion (q=3 in flight).
2nd winner: fixed-cell ΔE=+0.039 survives full relaxation (relaxed ΔE=+0.0886<0.10, m=0.00, bandwidth 0.544→0.411 eV). 5d works as well as 4d.

falsified.detail: ΔE=+0.260 eV, d⁸ overshoots E_F. d-count brackets the fill axis (d⁷=winner, d⁸=overshoot).
electron −0.445→−0.585 AND hole −0.445→−0.544 push the kagome flat band DEEPER from E_F; hole doping also wakes magnetism m→0.63. 'Dope CoSn to E_F' axis exhausted.

triangulation.v3: doping axis MEASURED-dead → new lane = sweep the CeCo3B2-type R-T₃-X₂ 4d/5d-kagome family (chemistry/lattice axis = 3.30 eV span, the real lever).
triangulation.v4: flat-band-at-E_F is a GRAPH property — two theorems generate hosts (line-graph: kagome=L(honeycomb)·pyrochlore=L(diamond)·checkerboard=L(square); bipartite imbalance: Lieb·dice/T3). Gate by two orthogonal screens (ΔE~0 AND non-magnetic). Bridge: Lieb=CuO₂-plane isomorph → links flat-band track to cuprate HTS.
triangulation.topology_sweep: CONCLUDED — Lieb Os-O 🔴 + checkerboard Os-O 🔴 (2/2 idealized Os-O realizations disperse the theorem flat band via O-bridge hybridization). Meta-finding (🧱 Os-O-realization wall): topology = necessary; realization (weak-hybridization d-kagome CeCo3B2) = the actual lever.
